summary: Extends plugins/plugin-native-system SystemLauncherApps with host-independent default-handler resolution for launcher hand-offs (roleIntent('dial') = ACTION_DIAL tel: with no data; resolveDefault(Context, role) -> available/packageName/label, never the host, a chooser reports no package) and bounded launcher icon rendering (iconPng(PackageManager, packageName, 16..512) -> PNG bytes or null).

contract.roleIntent: 'dial' -> new Intent(ACTION_DIAL, tel:) with no number, extras or component; any other role -> null
contract.resolveDefault: unknown role throws IllegalArgumentException; resolves with MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY; available=false when no non-host exported handler exists; packageName/label only for a single preferred handler that is not the host; never launches
contract.iconPng: size outside 16..512, missing package or unrenderable drawable -> null; otherwise a size x size PNG
contract.hostDuties: the host declares <queries> for the role intent (Alpha: android.intent.action.DIAL with scheme tel) and performs the launch only from an explicit user action
